name: Charlotte Wire & Cable Co
old_description: Charlotte Wire & Cable Company Inc. has been a trusted source for high-quality wire and cable products, with over 2,000 stock items and a combined 150,000 sq ft of warehouse and office space.
about:
Charlotte Wire & Cable Company Inc. was founded in 1993 by Mike Biggers in Concord, North Carolina. The company operates from a combined 150,000-square-foot warehouse and office facility in the Charlotte metropolitan area. Biggers remains president and founder, and the business has maintained a policy of selling exclusively through the electrical distribution channel since its inception.

The company stocks more than 2,000 wire and cable products, including building wire, utility wire, and specialized cables for industrial, commercial, and infrastructure applications. It functions as a wholesale distributor, providing 24/7 emergency service year‑round and emphasizing prompt, courteous customer support. Inventory is held in its Concord facility, allowing same‑day or next‑day shipment for many items.

Charlotte Wire & Cable serves four primary industry segments: industrial and manufacturing, residential and commercial construction, utility and infrastructure, and logistics and transportation. Its customer base consists of electrical distributors who rely on the company’s product breadth and distribution expertise to supply end‑users in those sectors.

Biggers has stated that the company’s founding principle was to support the electrical distribution channel rather than compete with it, a policy that continues to guide operations. The firm highlights its team’s average of over 12 years of industry experience, its round‑the‑clock emergency response, and its commitment to on‑time delivery as key differentiators.
